# Setup
```{r}
library(limma)

root.dir <- "/Users/pengja/PennNeurosurgery Dropbox/Jackie Peng/SilverbushLab/Projects/Jackie_post-mortem/"
suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(source(paste0(root.dir, "Code/", 'helper_functions.R'))))

classifier.input.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Classifier/", "input/")
classifier.output.dir <- paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "Classifier/", "output/")


dataset.use <- "my_data" # "my_data" or "phgg" or "herring2022"
method.use <- "all" # for my_data: all, FACS, 10X, or Invent

if (dataset.use == "phgg") {
  seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", 'Sussman_2024/', 'SeuratObjsFromLevel3ByPatientFinal/', 'all.samples.merged.not.downsampled.seurat.obj.w.annotations.RDS'))
  seurat.obj$annotation <- seurat.obj$annotation.l1
  seurat.obj$annotation.fine <- seurat.obj$annotation.l2
  
} else if (dataset.use == "my_data") {
  seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.FALSE_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/", "all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))
  
  #seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/", "my_data/", "autopsy/", "all_postmortem_samples_cellbender.FALSE_denoise.heat.shock.signature_postmortem.sensitive_postmortem.signature_filter.FALSE_batch.correction.None/", "seurat_objects/", "all_postmortem_samples_w_celltypes.velmeshev2019.RDS"))
  
  seurat.obj$annotation <- sapply(seurat.obj$celltype.by.cluster, function(x) case_when(
    x %in% c("Oligodendrocytes", "Astrocytes", "OPC") ~ "Glial",
    x %in% c("Inhibitory neurons", "Excitatory neurons") ~ "Neurons",
    x %in% c("Myeloid", "Lymphoid") ~ "Immune",
    TRUE ~ x
  ))
  seurat.obj$annotation.fine <- seurat.obj$celltype.by.cluster
     
  #seurat.obj$annotation <- seurat.obj$predicted.annotation_l1
  #seurat.obj$annotation.fine <- seurat.obj$predicted.annotation_l2
  
  if (method.use != "all") {
    seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, method == method.use)
    dataset.use <- paste0(dataset.use, "_", method.use)
  }
  
} else if (dataset.use == "herring2022") {
  seurat.obj <- readRDS(paste0(root.dir, "ExternalData/", 'Herring_2022/', 'processed/', 'all.sampled.merged.downsampled.seurat.obj.RDS'))
  seurat.obj$annotation <- sapply(seurat.obj$annotation_l1, function(x) case_when(
    x == "No.metadata" ~ "Filtered out",
    x == "Poor.Quality" ~ "Poor quality",
    TRUE ~ x
  ))
  seurat.obj$annotation.fine <- sapply(seurat.obj$annotation_l2, function(x) case_when(
    x == "No.metadata" ~ "Filtered out",
    x == "Poor.Quality" ~ "Poor quality",
    TRUE ~ x
  ))
  
  # remove non-patient
  seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = is.sample.organoid_ == FALSE)
} else {
  stop()
}

# remove malignant
seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = annotation != "Malignant cluster") 


# downsample
set.seed(123)
seurat.obj$downsample <- T
Idents(seurat.obj) <- "downsample"
seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, downsample == TRUE, downsample = 200000)


# remove very low quality
seurat.obj$filter.out <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.filter.out) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff.filter.out))
seurat.obj <- subset(seurat.obj, subset = filter.out == FALSE)

seurat.obj$low.quality.by.qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) (as.numeric(row[['nCount_RNA']]) < nCount_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['nFeature_RNA']]) < nFeature_RNA.cutoff.low) | (as.numeric(row[['percent.mt']]) > percent.mt.cutoff))

print(dim(seurat.obj))
```



# Format data for classifier
```{r}
format.for.classifier <- F

if (format.for.classifier) {
  variable.genes.df <- read.csv(paste0(root.dir, "ProcessedData/Sussman2024/tensor_decomposition/l1_top_10000_vf/input/", "variable.genes.tsv"), sep="\t")
  variable.genes <- variable.genes.df$variable.genes
  
  metadata <- seurat.obj@meta.data
  print(table(metadata$low.quality.by.qc))
  
  print(unique(metadata$annotation))
  write.table(metadata, paste0(classifier.input.dir, dataset.use, "_metadata.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = T, col.names = T, quote = F)
  
  # use top variable features from dataset intersected with variable features used for 3D tensor decomposition
  seurat.obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj, nfeatures = 5000)
  seurat.obj.variable.genes <- VariableFeatures(seurat.obj)
  
  if (dataset.use == "phgg") { # from the same dataset so no standardization needed
    genes.use <- intersect(variable.genes, seurat.obj.variable.genes)
    
  } else {
    # 1. Map both lists to official symbols to handle synonyms
    standardized_list1 <- alias2SymbolTable(variable.genes, species = "Hs")
    standardized_seurat <- alias2SymbolTable(seurat.obj.variable.genes, species = "Hs")
    
    # 2. Find the intersection of the "official" versions
    common_official <- intersect(standardized_list1, standardized_seurat)
    
    # 3. Filter the Seurat list to keep original names that mapped to the intersection
    genes.use <- seurat.obj.variable.genes[standardized_seurat %in% common_official]
    
    # Remove any NAs that might have been introduced during mapping
    genes.use <- na.omit(genes.use)
    print(length(genes.use))
  }
  
  
  #seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)
  seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj, scale.factor = 1000000)
  
  data <- FetchData(seurat.obj, vars = genes.use, layer = "data")
  write.table(data, paste0(classifier.input.dir, dataset.use, "_data.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = T, col.names = T, quote = F)
  
  
  # seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj, feautres = genes.use)
  # data <- FetchData(seurat.obj, vars = genes.use, layer = "scale.data")
  # write.table(data, paste0(classifier.input.dir, dataset.use, "_scale_data.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = T, col.names = T, quote = F)
  
  stop()
}
```

# Read in classifier output
Start here after running classifier in Python
```{r}
set.seed(123)
predictions.df <- read.csv(paste0(classifier.output.dir, dataset.use, "_predictions.tsv"), sep = "\t", row.names = 1)
seurat.obj <- AddMetaData(seurat.obj, predictions.df)

n.features.use <- 2000
seurat.obj <- NormalizeData(seurat.obj)


if (dataset.use == "phgg") {
  n.dims.use <- 10
} else if (dataset.use == "my_data") {
  n.dims.use <- 14
} else if (dataset.use == "my_data_FACS") {
  n.dims.use <- 15
} else if (dataset.use == "herring2022") {
  n.dims.use <- 7
}

seurat.obj <- FindVariableFeatures(seurat.obj, nfeatures = n.features.use)

for (denoise in c(F, T)) {
  
  if (denoise) {
    seurat.obj <- add.module.score(seurat.obj, gene.signatures[c("heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature")])
    seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj, vars.to.regress = c("heat.shock.signature", "postmortem.sensitive", "postmortem.signature"))
  } else {
    seurat.obj <- ScaleData(seurat.obj)
  }
  
  set.seed(123)
  seurat.obj <- RunPCA(seurat.obj, features = VariableFeatures(seurat.obj))
  ElbowPlot(seurat.obj, ndims = 50)
  
  if (dataset.use == "herring2022") {
    seurat.obj <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj, dims = 1:n.dims.use, min.dist = 0.3)
  } else {
    seurat.obj <- RunUMAP(seurat.obj, dims = 1:n.dims.use, min.dist = 0.1)
  }
  
  cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.herring <- c(cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality, "Poor quality", "Filtered out", "Unassigned", "Glial OPC")
  cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale.herring <- scale_color_manual(breaks=cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.herring, values=c(cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.colors, "brown", "grey", "#EEEEEE", "#CC79A7"))
  
  cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.herring <- c(cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality, "Poor quality", "Filtered out")
  cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.color.scale.herring <- scale_color_manual(breaks=cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.herring, values=c(as.character(cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.colors), "brown", "grey"))
  
  p.low.quality <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "low.quality.by.qc", label = F, shuffle = T) + umap.axes + scale_color_manual(values=c("grey", "red")) + ggtitle("Low quality")
  p.labels.initial <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "labels_initial", label = F, shuffle = T) + umap.axes + cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale.herring + ggtitle("Classifier predictions")
  p.labels.final <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "labels_final", label = F, shuffle = T) + umap.axes + cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale.herring + ggtitle("Classifier predictions")
  
  seurat.obj$annotation_l1_w_opc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) ifelse(row[["annotation.fine"]] == "OPC", "Glial OPC", row[["annotation"]]))
  seurat.obj$annotation_l1_w_opc <- factor(seurat.obj$annotation_l1_w_opc, levels = c("Glial", "Glial OPC", "Immune", "Neurons", "Vascular", "Poor quality", "Filtered out"))
  
  p.annotation.l1 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "annotation_l1_w_opc", label = F, shuffle = T) + umap.axes + cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale.herring + ggtitle("Original annotations")
  p.annotation.l2 <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "annotation.fine", label = F, shuffle = T) + umap.axes + cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.color.scale.herring + ggtitle("Original annotations")
  p.labels.final.pca <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "labels_final", label = F, shuffle = T, reduction = "pca") + umap.axes + cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale.herring + ggtitle("Classifier predictions")
  p.annotation.l2.pca <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "annotation.fine", label = F, shuffle = T, reduction = "pca") + umap.axes + cell.types.anotation_l2.w.quality.color.scale.herring + ggtitle("Original annotations")
  p <- p.low.quality + p.labels.initial + p.labels.final + p.annotation.l1 + p.annotation.l2 + p.labels.final.pca + p.annotation.l2.pca
  
  pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Results/tensor_decomposition/classifier/umap/", dataset.use, "_denoise=", denoise, "_umap_ndims=", n.dims.use, "_n.features.use=", n.features.use, ".pdf"), width = 18, height = 12)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
  
  
  
  
  
  
  # identify low quality cells
  if (dataset.use == "herring2022") {
    seurat.obj$filtered.out <- seurat.obj$annotation_l1_w_opc == "Filtered out"
    Idents(seurat.obj) <- "filtered.out"
    seurat.obj$annotation_l1_w_opc_and_qc <- seurat.obj$annotation_l1_w_opc
  } else {
    Idents(seurat.obj) <- "low.quality.by.qc"
    seurat.obj$annotation_l1_w_opc_and_qc <- apply(seurat.obj@meta.data, 1, function(row) 
      ifelse(as.logical(row[["low.quality.by.qc"]]) == TRUE,
      "Low quality",
      row[["annotation_l1_w_opc"]]
    ))
  }
  
  
  
  low_quality_cells <- WhichCells(seurat.obj, idents = TRUE)
  other_cells <- WhichCells(seurat.obj, idents = FALSE)
  cell_order <- c(other_cells, low_quality_cells)
  
  cells_to_highlight <- low_quality_cells
  
  
  # low quality cells on top
  p.annotation.l1.w.qc <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, 
                                  group.by = "annotation_l1_w_opc_and_qc", 
                                  cells = cell_order,
                                  label = F, 
                                  shuffle = F,
                                  raster = F) + 
                           umap.axes + 
                           cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale.herring + 
                           ggtitle("Original annotations")
  
  
  # 1. Create the base plot
  # Note: We use the original annotations and specific cell order here
  p.annotation.l1.w.qc <- DimPlot(
      seurat.obj, 
      group.by = "annotation_l1_w_opc_and_qc", 
      cells = cell_order,
      label = F, 
      shuffle = F,
      raster = F
    ) + 
    umap.axes + 
    cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale.herring + 
    ggtitle("Original annotations")
  
  # 2. Add the highlight layers
  # This adds the black border first, then the colored center on top
  p.annotation.l1.w.qc_final <- p.annotation.l1.w.qc + 
    # Black stroke layer
    geom_point(
      data = p.annotation.l1.w.qc$data[cells_to_highlight, ], 
      aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2), 
      color = "black", 
      size = 1  # Adjust size for thicker/thinner border
    ) +
    # Front color layer
    geom_point(
      data = p.annotation.l1.w.qc$data[cells_to_highlight, ], 
      aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = annotation_l1_w_opc_and_qc), 
      size = 0.1
    )
  
  
  
  
  # base plot
  p.prediction <- DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "labels_final", shuffle = T, raster = F) + 
       umap.axes + 
       cell.types.anotation_l1.w.quality.color.scale.herring +
       ggtitle("Classifier predictions")
  
  # black stroke layer
  p.prediction_final <- p.prediction + 
    geom_point(
      data = p.prediction$data[cells_to_highlight, ], 
      aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2), 
      color = "black", 
      size = 1 # The "Border"
    ) +
  # front color layer
    geom_point(
      data = p.prediction$data[cells_to_highlight, ], 
      aes(x = umap_1, y = umap_2, color = labels_final), 
      size = 0.1 # The "Center"
    )

  
  p <- p.annotation.l1.w.qc_final + p.prediction_final
  pdf(paste0(root.dir, "Figures/", "Figure 2/", dataset.use, "_denoise=", denoise, "_umap_classifier_predictions.pdf"), width = 16, height = 6)
  print(p)
  dev.off()
}

FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("MBP", "MOG"), order = T)
```
